questions.name: Git vs GitHub
questions.question_text: Which statement best describes the difference between Git and GitHub?

answers.text: Git is version-control software on your computer; GitHub is a website that hosts a remote copy of your repository
answers.html: Git is version-control software on your computer; GitHub is a website that hosts a remote copy of your repository

answers.text: Git is the online service and GitHub is the local software
answers.html: Git is the online service and GitHub is the local software

answers.text: They are two names for the same tool
answers.html: They are two names for the same tool

answers.text: Git edits code; GitHub runs it in the browser
answers.html: Git edits code; GitHub runs it in the browser

questions.name: First recovery command
questions.question_text: Something feels off in your local repository — you are not sure whether your work is committed or in sync with GitHub. Which command should you run first?

answers.text: Delete the folder and clone again

questions.name: Asking for help
questions.question_text: You are stuck on a setup step and a command keeps failing. According to the course help workflow, what should you do first?

answers.text: Post in the Help & Questions board with what you tried and the exact error message
answers.html: Post in the Help & Questions board with what you tried and the exact error message

answers.text: Email the instructor a screenshot with no other details
answers.html: Email the instructor a screenshot with no other details

answers.text: Wait until the deadline and request an extension
answers.html: Wait until the deadline and request an extension

answers.html: Try random Git commands until one works
